subject: Supplier onboarding: insurance checklist & PO setup — quick Qs
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Anna Torres <anna@lumenvault.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier onboarding: insurance checklist & PO setup — quick Qs

Hi Anna —

Thanks for progressing LumenVault's onboarding with us. Procurement asked me to confirm a few insurance and PO items we need to finalize before we can issue a purchase order and enable billing. Can you review and confirm the following by EOD Thursday if possible?

1) Certificates / endorsements we require:
   - Certificate of Insurance (COI) showing General Liability (min $1M per occurrence / $2M aggregate) and Employers Liability or Workers' Comp as applicable.
   - Additional Insured endorsement naming: "Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors, employees and agents" — endorsement must be on primary and noncontributory wording if the insurer can provide it.
   - Waiver of Subrogation in favor of Redwood Inference where available.
   - Cyber/Network liability coverage (we typically request $1M) — if cyber is a shared program, please include a statement of shared limits.

2) Policy dates & retroactive coverage: please confirm policy effective/expiration dates and whether the cyber policy has prior acts coverage.

3) Subcontractors: Does the policy cover subcontractors or do you need us to list any subcontracted work on the endorsement?

4) Invoicing / PO details needed to issue procurement's PO: legal entity name, remit-to address, W-9 (US vendors), and preferred payment terms (Net30/Net45). Also confirm ACH details if you want electronic payment (bank name, account, routing — or we can use Bill.com).

5) If any of the above cannot be provided as requested, please flag which items and include the insurer contact for any endorsement negotiations.

I attached our COI requirements checklist to make it easy. If you can send the COI and any cyber certificate, we can have procurement review for PO issuance.

Thanks —
Mateo Alvarez
Vendor Programs | Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: Redwood_COI_requirements_v2.pdf
From: Anna Torres <anna@lumenvault.com>

Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding: insurance checklist & PO setup — quick Qs

Hello Mateo / Irene —

Thanks for the clear list. Please find attached our current COI and our cyber liability certificate. A few notes up front:

- COI attached: LumenVault_Certificate_2026-06-22.pdf (shows GL $2M agg, $1M per occ).
- Cyber certificate attached: LumenVault_Cyber_Cert_2026-06-22.pdf (limits $1M, retroactive date 2019-04-01).
- Our insurer has confirmed they can add Redwood Inference as Additional Insured; however, they are unable to provide a primary/noncontributory endorsement due to our master policy wording. They said they can add a Waiver of Subrogation.

If primary/noncontributory is a hard requirement, we can request an exception from underwriting but that could take 7–10 business days.

W-9 is on file in our portal; I can attach it if you prefer. Remit-to: LumenVault, Inc., 720 Meridian Ave, Suite 210, Palo Alto, CA 94301. ACH details available after we receive a PO form. Payment terms: Net30.

Let us know if the absence of primary/noncontributory disqualifies the account or if Waiver + Additional Insured is acceptable.

Best,
Anna Torres
Head of Finance Operations | LumenVault
anna@lumenvault.com | +1 (650) 777-2210

Attachments: LumenVault_Certificate_2026-06-22.pdf, LumenVault_Cyber_Cert_2026-06-22.pdf
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Anna Torres <anna@lumenvault.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding: insurance checklist & PO setup — quick Qs

Hi Anna —

Appreciate the quick turn. A few clarifications so procurement can process without delays:

- Additional Insured + Waiver of Subrogation is acceptable to start, provided the insurer confirms in writing the endorsement language that names Redwood Inference as described in our checklist. Please paste the exact endorsement text or provide the insurer contact so procurement can confirm.

- For our records we need: insurer name, policy number(s), effective / expiry dates visible on the COI, and the claim contact (email/phone).

- Regarding primary/noncontributory: Procurement flagged it as preferred but not always mandatory. If underwriting pushback is expected, please ask them to confirm whether an alternate form of acknowledgment (e.g., explicit statement that Redwood will be treated as Additional Insured for liability arising from LumenVault's services) can be provided.

- Subcontractors: please confirm whether your policy automatically extends to subcontractors performing work on our behalf. If not, list any planned subs and we will review.

- W-9: yes please attach the W-9 PDF to this thread so we can match tax/legal entity details against the PO.

Dylan — looping you in to begin creating a provisional PO once LumenVault confirms the endorsement language and we get the W-9. If procurement needs any specific vendor form filled, I've attached the vendor_po_template.xlsx.

Thanks —
Mateo

Hi Anna —

Thanks for the docs and the note. Procurement is comfortable proceeding on Additional Insured + Waiver of Subrogation for now. A couple of quick next steps so we can finalize a PO: 

1) Please paste the endorsement language or have your insurer email procurement at procurement@redwood.com with the endorsement text. That will let us close compliance checks.
2) Attach the W-9 to this thread (or confirm TIN and legal entity exactly as on the W-9).
3) Confirm whether subcontractors are covered or provide a short list of expected subs.

Once we have the endorsement text and W-9, I'll issue a provisional PO (PO-12345) and send a PO stub for signature/acceptance. Expected payment terms Net30; payment via ACH preferred — when you share banking we can mark the PO with remittance details.

I'll attach the provisional PO stub for your review. If anything changes on underwriting (e.g., they can provide primary/noncontributory), we can update the PO and endorsement.

Regards,
